lessons.rule: Most fixes are an existing bullet in `docs/notes/` applied in a new place: search the notes for the area before writing a fix.
lessons.evidence: Before the loop's first run: the repository's CLAUDE.md (since 2026-10-27 its notes in docs/notes/) is the record of every mistake the add-on already made.

lessons.rule: A `display` set on a class beats the `[hidden]` attribute: when a container is toggled with `hidden`, check its class does not set `display`.
lessons.evidence: First UX audit: an empty hidden container (.kclean) drew as a bar in Memory › Knowledge.

lessons.rule: A `[Producer …] ignored N of M` fault drops out once nobody marked the rule Wrong for 14 days (`reports.SCORE_RECENT_S`); only a Wrong count above what the fixed cause explains is new evidence.
lessons.evidence: 2026-10-09: the fault read the all-time scorecard and kept reporting after the rule was fixed; fixed at the source on 2026-10-19.

lessons.rule: Never `pkill -f <pattern>` in the same Bash command as anything else, and never kill a process you did not start.
lessons.evidence: The pattern matched the shell running the command (exit 144): three suite runs lost. 2026-10-27: a subagent's `pkill -f pytest` could kill another worktree's run.

lessons.rule: A severity is not a category: a chip that sorts rows asks the source too, never the severity alone.
lessons.evidence: `sec.*` checks file at info and answers.chip read every info row as Tidy-up, folding security findings away.

lessons.rule: Run `devloop_guard.py` after committing: it reads committed changes only, so a dirty tree reads as ok.
lessons.evidence: A guard run on a dirty tree said ok while the commit broke a rule CI's devloop-guard then caught.

lessons.rule: A Morph panel serving `/morph_static/<older version>/` is Home Assistant still running the old integration: a restart is pending, not a Morph bug.
lessons.evidence: Reports against /morph_static/0.1.0/.

lessons.rule: Always pass `commit_title` and `commit_message` to `merge_pull_request`: without them the squash message carries every commit, including dropped ones.
lessons.evidence: The history-cutoff change dropped in review still landed its message on main (#437).

lessons.rule: Read the release a report was filed against (the block's `release`) before fixing: a report a later release already fixed is closed as a duplicate of the fixing issue.
lessons.evidence: Reports filed against versions older than the fix; 2026-10-27, 20 snapshot faults from one Core restart were already fixed by 3.8.26.

lessons.rule: Read the lines before a log's sign-off before naming a cause, and say in the PR when the cause is still unproven.
lessons.evidence: 'run found error, return N' in a Bambu Studio slice log is flush_and_exit signing off; a fix written to that line could not be aimed (#328).

lessons.rule: A live picture needs a second element swapped in once decoded; a measure that samples an image waits for `complete && naturalWidth > 0`.
lessons.evidence: Swapping an img src blanks a frame even when the URL is decoded elsewhere; a lazily loaded image measured blank.

lessons.rule: CodeQL comments land after a PR merged: check the last merged PR's threads at the start of each batch, and grep new tests for import styles CodeQL flags.
lessons.evidence: Import cycles, mixed `import unittest` / `from unittest import mock`, a statement with no effect, an `import x` inside a function when x is imported at the top (10-23, 10-27, 11-03).

lessons.rule: After a squash merge, merging `main` into a follow-up branch conflicts on its own earlier changes: take the branch's side and confirm `git diff origin/main` shows only new work.
lessons.evidence: Seen on every pipelined batch after a squash merge; version lines and the CHANGELOG head conflict the same way (11-03).

lessons.rule: Check whether one fault filed as two issues is a fingerprint split by moving wording, and say so to the house half.
lessons.evidence: #358 and #365 looked like one fault.

lessons.rule: Reach an optional HA component through `power_tools._component` rather than adding it to `manifest.json`: the guard lets only the version line change, and hassfest refuses a URL in strings.
lessons.evidence: hassfest wants every component an integration uses in dependencies.

lessons.rule: `issue_write` with `labels` REPLACES every label: close by POSTing the comment, POSTing the label, then PATCHing `state=closed`.
lessons.evidence: Closing with devloop:fixed dropped from-house and the stream label.

lessons.rule: Subagents in parallel worktrees never `git stash` (a WIP commit instead) and never kill processes they did not start.
lessons.evidence: Two batch agents shared one stash; one ran pkill -f pytest.

lessons.rule: Find Chromium with `ls /opt/pw-browsers` rather than a remembered path; in a cloud session browser tests need `BRAIN_CHROMIUM` set to the headless shell.
lessons.evidence: The path moved to chromium-1243; the full browser hangs on --dump-dom in the cloud.

lessons.rule: Two prepared batches that rewrote the same sentences or the same listener merge both intents (the batch's own subagent does it), then bump and add the CHANGELOG entry.
lessons.evidence: sre.py and checks/integrations.py (10-28), morph-panel.js scroll listener (10-29).

lessons.rule: Before assuming a permission gap, read the refusal's wording and the prompts: the tool may never have been missing.
lessons.evidence: A subagent found the dashboard tools present; the refusal was wording (Lovelace).

lessons.rule: A subagent's brief says 'if it exists' for a file named only in an issue: the house's own copy is not in this repository.
lessons.evidence: islandbar.js named from issue text did not exist here.

lessons.rule: An owner request that asks for a permission usually has a part that needs none; the additive `/config/.brain/ui/house.css`/`house.js` layer answered 'I can't change my own header'.
lessons.evidence: #528 fixed as an additive house layer, not a writable /opt/panel.

lessons.rule: Read every new refusal regex against everyday sentences and give it a negative test list.
lessons.evidence: A fork floor threw away 'check whether the filter is clogged'; a retired matcher took 'I don't have time' as retired.

lessons.rule: A series of owner `look` reports on one control is one spec read latest-first.
lessons.evidence: Six rail reports in two hours.

lessons.rule: Run `python3 .github/scripts/check.py --base origin/main` (its bump stage) and grep the old version across the add-on before pushing a bump: GardenRX and BRUH Print pin it in several files.
lessons.evidence: GardenRX: app/package.json, the lockfile, const.py, CARD_VERSION; BRUH Print: lovelace/bruh-print-card.js.

lessons.rule: A PR that touches two add-ons bumps both versions and keeps both CHANGELOG sections when the next batch conflicts.
lessons.evidence: One add-on's tool passing through another's.

lessons.rule: A Dependabot major bump can ride a devloop PR after it is tested (a local build; `npm update <pkg> --package-lock-only` within the parent's range), with the add-on's version bump.
lessons.evidence: Sight's Gradle image and a transitive npm package.

lessons.rule: Write service help text without angle brackets or colons, and parse services.yaml with yaml.safe_load before pushing.
lessons.evidence: hassfest refused <name> in a service field's description, and an unquoted description containing ': ' was a YAML mapping error (2026-11-04).

lessons.rule: A batch that needs a sibling add-on's new service is split: the add-on's half ships first as its own PR and version, then brAIn's half, which treats the service as optional for an older add-on.
lessons.evidence: BRUH Minecraft 1.19.6's boss bar shipped before brAIn used it (#579, 2026-11-04).

lessons.rule: Run at most three subagents at a time on a 4-CPU container; read a local failure that also fails on main against main and let CI be the gate.
lessons.evidence: Four subagents killed xdist workers (node down), one Sonnet batch took 80 minutes, and a leftover /config/.brain made test_morph_personality fail locally on main too (2026-11-04).

lessons.rule: An unattributed canary signal reverts the whole release, even a fix the owner confirmed: fix a recurring fault on its own before shipping on top of it, and say in the decline how to re-apply the reverted change.
lessons.evidence: Canary #817 (brAIn 5.1.27) regressed on #577 coming back; no file of BRUH-HA-Apps #631 explained it, so #637 reverted #631 although the owner had confirmed #809 fixed on 5.1.27.

lessons.rule: Reverting a PR whose tests were later deleted: keep them deleted, and check that git diff <sha>^ HEAD over the code files is empty.
lessons.evidence: #637 reverted #631 after 8c61f55 had deleted its two test files; the revert touched no grader.

lessons.rule: Register `addCleanup` with the original BEFORE replacing a module function, or the cleanup restores the fake and leaks into a later class.
lessons.evidence: A leaked fake failed SceneDesignCase later in the same xdist worker.

lessons.rule: Check a local-only failure against `main` (and run the file alone) before chasing it: stray files under `/config/.brain` or `/data` from an earlier test break later ones.
lessons.evidence: 2026-10-10 a stray /config/.brain/memory failed test_task_failures on main; 2026-10-23 two test_usage_tracker renewal tests failed beside another that left files in /data.

lessons.rule: A test that depends on optional data (zoneinfo) gets a fallback that keeps it running, never a new skip: the monitor flags a new skip marker.
lessons.evidence: devloop-guard refused a new skipIf in a timezone test.

lessons.rule: Batches that add MCP tools conflict on the `TOOLS` list in `ha_mcp_server.py` and the documented count: merge both sides, re-add a whole `TOOLS` entry, and recount by hand.
lessons.evidence: Two batches each added tools.

lessons.rule: A test that starts a background job waits for it (an Event set in a `finally`) before tearDown removes its directory.
lessons.evidence: test_bambu_copies raced its own cleanup.

lessons.rule: Never make a fix pass by changing an existing test: `tests/*.py` is a grader path the guard refuses on a devloop branch; when a pinned assertion contradicts the fix, decline the issue naming the test's path:line.
lessons.evidence: 2026-10-18 two subagents moved a fixture and rewrote an assertion despite the prompt; 2026-10-20 #327 and #322 were blocked by pinned assertions (test_resident_unjudged.py:63, test_open_row_look_reason.py:60, test_rhythm.py:110).

lessons.rule: A hung or cancelled CI job is read from its log for a runner shutdown and re-run once before looking for a code cause.
lessons.evidence: Dead xdist workers hung Python tests for 6 h (10-18), 40 min (10-24) and 45 min (10-30); every job now has timeout-minutes.

lessons.rule: A test that files at a fixed time reads back at that same clock, never the real one.
lessons.evidence: test_hypothesis_days failed on every branch once real time passed its fixed day.

lessons.rule: With several fixer agents at once, each runs only `check.py` and the guard on its own branch; CI is the gate, and a local failure under load is checked against main first.
lessons.evidence: 11 parallel subagents pushed load past 45 and every local affected run died on xdist.

retired.evidence: Every add-on update re-opened every fault issue (#246); fixed at the source in brAIn 3.0.9.

retired.why: Fixed at the source in 3.0.9 (upstream._follow_up); every house runs 4.x, where a Back again is evidence (SKILL.md step 2).
